Monte Carlo intervals from the normal approximation

ms_intervals.Rd

Draws (items, curve coefficients, g) from the normal approximation of [ms_vcov()] and pushes each draw through `target(a, d, act)`, which returns a named numeric vector (thresholds, crosswalk values, ...). Every curve draw is projected onto the non-increasing cone.

Usage

ms_intervals(fit, vc, target, n_draw = 1000, level = 0.95, seed = NULL)

Arguments

fit

a [fit_ms()] result

vc

its [ms_vcov()]

target

function(a, d, act) returning a named numeric vector

n_draw

number of draws

level

interval level

seed

optional RNG seed

Value

data.frame(param, est, se, lo, hi)

Details

Use these intervals for item parameters, latent thresholds, thresholds on the digital scale within the data and the probabilistic crosswalk. Do not use them for the curve \(\mu(\eta)\): they condition on the selected boosting path and miss most of its sampling variance; use [ms_bootstrap()].
